title: When ego keeps making the self too large under pressure
issueStatement: The self keeps pushing itself to the center of the room. Pressure exposes what the mind reaches for when it feels cornered.
centralInsight: Guru names haumai clearly and then redirects the heart toward humility, service, and truth. Pressure becomes revealing when the line is allowed to interrupt panic and performance.
practicalReflection: The cure begins when ego is seen as illness rather than identity. Notice where the self wants the line to confirm it instead of soften it.
actionPrompt: Notice where the self wants the line to confirm it instead of soften it. Use the line before the pressure decides the tone.
